Summary: The judgment command: do not condemn others while blind to your own faults; judge with right judgment.
Commandment: Do not judge hypocritically; first take the plank from your own eye, then judge with right judgment.
Application: The command does not forbid all judgment — John 7:24 commands right judgment — but it forbids the hypocrite's judgment, which condemns in others what it excuses in itself.
Purpose: To forbid hypocritical condemnation while commanding right judgment (John 7:24).
Function: The command does not forbid all judgment — John 7:24 commands right judgment — but it forbids the hypocrite's judgment. Not Mosaic law but a New Testament command — the threefold division does not sort it. Its goal was to forbid hypocritical condemnation while commanding right judgment. The evil it addressed was the beam ignored and the mote condemned — judging in others what is excused in oneself. It restrained that evil by the order itself: first cast out the beam out of thine own eye.
